prompt:
I have a blog post that's performing incredibly well:

Title: "How AI Agents Cut Compliance Review Time from 6 Weeks to 3 Days"
URL: example.com/blog/ai-compliance-speed
Metrics: Ranking #1 for "AI compliance automation", 6.2% CTR, 580 conversions/month, avg time on page 4:32

Key sections:
- Introduction: The compliance bottleneck problem (most companies spend 6-12 weeks per review cycle)
- The AI solution: How autonomous agents handle evidence collection, policy mapping, and gap analysis
- Case study: TechCorp reduced review time by 92% (6 weeks → 3 days)
- Implementation: 3-step setup process
- ROI calculation: $180K annual savings

Adapt this for Meta/TikTok ads and Google ads. I want to use this winning angle in paid campaigns.
expectations: Extracts core insight about speed/time savings as the winning angle
Provides Meta/TikTok ad hook that compresses '6 weeks → 3 days' into first 3 seconds
Includes 45-60 second script with problem → solution → proof → CTA structure
Mentions handoff to dtc-ad-strategy skill for full campaign execution
Provides Google ad headlines (30 chars) and descriptions (90 chars)
Preserves the TechCorp case study as social proof in adaptations
Includes character count verification for each ad element
Creates preservation map showing what stayed consistent (speed angle, 92% stat) vs what changed (format, length)

prompt:
We have an email nurture sequence that converts at 18% (way above our 7% average):

**Subject:** "Why your compliance process is stuck in 2015"
**Email 1 (Day 0):** Problem amplification - manual compliance is slow, error-prone, expensive
**Email 2 (Day 2):** Solution introduction - autonomous AI agents that work 24/7
**Email 3 (Day 5):** Social proof - 3 case studies with metrics
**Email 4 (Day 7):** CTA - Book a compliance audit with urgency (limited slots)

Conversion: 18% book audit, 12% convert to paid within 30 days

I want to turn this into:
1. A landing page for cold traffic
2. LinkedIn posts (we have 15K followers)
3. Twitter thread

Keep the narrative arc but optimize for each channel.
expectations: Identifies the winning formula: problem amplification + social proof + urgency
Adapts email sequence arc into landing page hero section (Email 1 problem → hero headline)
Transforms Email 2-3 into landing page benefits + social proof sections
Preserves Email 4 urgency in landing page CTA
Creates LinkedIn post (1300 chars) with professional tone expanding on key insight
Generates Twitter thread (5-7 tweets) breaking down the sequence into standalone tweets
Includes preservation map showing consistent elements (narrative arc, social proof, urgency) vs channel-specific changes
Recommends handoff to direct-response skill for landing page CRO optimization

prompt:
We're launching new product messaging for ComplyEasyAI and need it rolled out across all marketing channels:

**Core Positioning:**
- Angle: "Compliance that scales with you (not against you)"
- Promise: "Grow from 10 to 1000 employees without hiring a compliance team"
- Proof: "Autonomous platform handles 90% of compliance work"
- Audience: Series A-C SaaS companies (10-500 employees)
- Emotion: Fear of compliance becoming a growth blocker + aspiration for efficient scaling

Adapt this for all relevant channels. We're launching in 2 weeks and need complete, ready-to-use content.
expectations: Generates adaptations for all 7 supported channels (Meta/TikTok, Google/LinkedIn, SEO, Email, Landing Pages, Social, Lead Magnets)
Maintains consistent angle ('compliance that scales with you') across all channels
Preserves key proof point ('90% of compliance work') in every adaptation
Adapts format appropriately: compressed for ads, expanded for SEO, personal for email, visual for landing pages
Includes specific deliverables: ad scripts, headlines, H1s, subject lines, hero sections, social posts, lead magnet titles
Creates comprehensive preservation map showing what stayed consistent vs what changed per channel
Recommends which channels to launch first based on typical product launch strategy
Suggests handoffs to specialized skills where appropriate (dtc-ad-strategy for ads, lead-magnet-cro for downloadables)

prompt:

prompt:
Adapt this for LinkedIn and a lead magnet:

**Source:** Product feature announcement email
**Subject:** "New: AI-powered policy mapper cuts compliance setup from weeks to hours"
**Body:** Explains new feature that auto-maps company policies to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA). Shows before/after: 3 weeks manual mapping → 4 hours automated.
**Metrics:** 34% open rate, 12% click-through to demo request

I want a LinkedIn thought leadership post and a downloadable lead magnet concept.
expectations: Creates LinkedIn post (1300 chars) positioning the time savings as an industry insight, not just a feature announcement
Generates lead magnet concept: likely a template/calculator (e.g., 'Compliance Framework Mapping Template' or 'Policy Mapping ROI Calculator')
Preserves core proof point (3 weeks → 4 hours) in both adaptations
Includes lead magnet title, positioning, and hook based on email's winning angle
Recommends handoff to lead-magnet-cro skill for full interactive tool creation
Shows how feature announcement translates to thought leadership (LinkedIn) and practical resource (lead magnet)
Explains why these two channels were selected (LinkedIn for reach, lead magnet for capture)

prompt:

Audience: B2B SaaS founders and sales leaders
Emotion: Aspiration (close bigger deals faster) + urgency (competitors are moving faster)
CTA: Download enterprise sales playbook

Adapt this for ads, email, and a landing page.

Creates Meta/TikTok ad hook emphasizing revenue angle (not traditional cost/risk framing)
Generates email subject lines testing different psychological triggers (aspiration, urgency, social proof)
